headline: 7 suspended as probe committee formed over Kashimpur prison escape
summary: Authorities are investigating the security breach that allowed inmates to escape from the Kashimpur prison.
details: A probe committee has been formed to investigate the escape of inmates from Kashimpur prison.
In response to the security failure, seven prison officials have been suspended from their duties.
The investigation will look into how the breach occurred and identify those responsible for the negligence.
Security measures are being reviewed to prevent similar incidents in the future.

headline_marked: 2 dead, 12 injured in [[road accident involving wedding party]] in Nilphamari
headline: 2 dead, 12 injured in road accident involving wedding party in Nilphamari
summary: A 7-month-old baby and a 20-year-old student were killed when a microbus carrying a bride and groom fell into a ditch.
details: A tragic road accident in Nilphamari has claimed the lives of two people, including a 7-month-old baby, while leaving at least 12 others injured.
The incident occurred early Saturday morning in the Shaltibari area of the Kishoreganj-Tengnamari road in Kishoreganj Upazila.
A microbus carrying 15 to 16 wedding guests was returning from a wedding ceremony in Jugipara, Kishoreganj Upazila, to the Bandarpara area of Kochukata Union in Nilphamari Sadar Upazila.
The driver lost control of the vehicle, causing the microbus to plunge into a roadside ditch.
The deceased have been identified as 7-month-old Jiban Islam and 20-year-old Riyad Islam, an HSC candidate.
At least 12 injured people, including the bride and groom, were rescued and admitted to Rangpur Medical College Hospital, where some are in critical condition.
Kishoreganj Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Abdul Gafur confirmed that the bodies have been handed over to the families after legal formalities.
caption:

A microbus carrying 15 to 16 wedding guests was returning from a wedding ceremony in Jugipara, Kishoreganj Upazila, to the Bandarpara area of Kochukata Union in Nilphamari Sadar Upazila.

The driver lost control of the vehicle, causing the microbus to plunge into a roadside ditch.

The deceased have been identified as 7-month-old Jiban Islam and 20-year-old Riyad Islam, an HSC candidate.

At least 12 injured people, including the bride and groom, were rescued and admitted to Rangpur Medical College Hospital, where some are in critical condition.

Kishoreganj Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Abdul Gafur confirmed that the bodies have been handed over to the families after legal formalities.
